name: Dont Hide Your Light
overview: Scripture calls believers to openly display the light of Christ in their lives, refusing to conceal the good works God enables them to do. Jesus teaches that a candle is meant to be placed on a stand to give light to all in the house, symbolizing how Christians should let their faith shine visibly so others may glorify God. This confidence to shine comes from God's promise to strengthen and uphold His people, reminding us that with God nothing is impossible. Conversely, those who practice evil avoid the light to keep their deeds hidden, highlighting the importance of living transparently in the truth of Christ.
